Description
ShockEvent T is a dual-chamber vertical shock test chamber. The hot chamber (top) and cold chamber (below) are arranged on top of each other. It compresses the "transfer zone" between the cold and hot zones with a transfer time. The test specimen moves between these two chambers in a basket secured with protection grids. The weisstechnik vertical shock chambers allow the performance of endurance tests of over 1000 cycles without defrosting. 
This makes the ShockEvent T unique. 
Protect your valuable test material. 
Triple test material fuse included as standard. Active test items can be deenergized via a potential-free contact. Test chamber can switch off in the event of a fault in the test material or be set to a defined value (optional). 
User-Friendliness and Connectivity 
A color touchscreen display with intuitive menu navigation tailored to the vertical shock test chambers, along with the optional SIMPATI® software, enables easy programming, remote monitoring, and network connectivity. 
Exceptionally high load-bearing capacity and durability 
The test chambers are designed to accommodate test specimens weighing up to 100 kg in the lifting basket and to perform more than 1,000 cycles without defrosting. This ensures low maintenance requirements, longer operating times, and maximum operational reliability. 
Flexibility and a wide range of standards 
The vertical shock test chambers comply with a wide range of international testing standards (including MIL-STD 810, MIL-STD 883, IEC 60068-2-14, and JESD22-A101-A) and offer over 30 different options, making them versatile enough to meet the testing needs of a wide variety of industries and applications.
